goal:
Resolvable per-stage chain events with web drilldown
WHY: Fixes F2 medium drilldown gap: T7 chain event_ids point at bare {evidence_id} placeholder events no endpoint can resolve, so README drilldown and web Evidence page dead-end.

SPEC: Add GET /v1/events/{event_id} returning {id, stage/kind, evidence_id, summary} with 404 on unknown; summary carries per-stage facts already stored server-side (e.g. command_id, gate verdicts, review result, PR url, run counts) and never embeds held-out test code. Replace _link_stages placeholder payloads {evidence_id} with these stage summaries. Web: apps/web/lib/api.ts adds getEvent(event_id); apps/web/app/evidence/page.tsx makes each non-null stage id clickable to fetch and render the event summary, keeping null stages as 증거 부족.

ACCEPTANCE (your own plan): Every non-null event_id in GET /v1/evidence/{id}.chain resolves via GET /v1/events/{event_id} with matching stage and owning evidence id; Unknown event id returns 404; missing stages stay null and are never fabricated; Evidence page click on a stage fetches and displays the event summary; web build passes; No held-out test code appears in chain, event, or evidence bodies; python -m pytest services/api -q passes
OUT OF SCOPE: services/api/evoforge/postgres_kernel.py; services/api/evoforge/kernel_api.py; docs/POSTGRES_KERNEL.md; docs/INTERNAL_KERNEL_API.md; gate verdict rules and ledger math
check: cd apps\web && node node_modules\typescript\bin\tsc --noEmit --incremental false -p . && node node_modules\next\dist\bin\next build
